faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in UCSL Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for Diploma Apprentice posts in Udupi Cochin Shipyard Recruitment 2026. These include positions in Mechanical and Electrical Engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What are the important dates for UCSL Diploma Apprentice applications?
faq.answer: The online application process for UCSL Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026 starts on 15 September 2026 and the last date to apply online is 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for UCSL Diploma Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the UCSL Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026, making it accessible for all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to UCSL Diploma Apprentice positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 18 years old to be eligible for the Diploma Apprentice posts at Udupi Cochin Shipyard. There is no maximum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Diploma Apprentice in UCSL?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Diploma Apprentice posts at Udupi Cochin Shipyard will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 13200. This is a competitive stipend for apprentice roles.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for UCSL Diploma Apprentice Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for Diploma Apprentice posts includes Certificate Verification, evaluation based on Merit/Reservation, and a Medical Fitness examination to ensure suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the UCSL Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of Udupi Cochin Shipyard. The application window is from 15 September 2026 to 14 October 2026. Ensure all documents are uploaded correctly.

faq.question: Q8. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Engineering or Technology in the relevant discipline, such as Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering, from a recognized institution to be eligible.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for UCSL Diploma Apprentice?
faq.answer: The job location for the Diploma Apprentice posts will be in Malpe, Karnataka, which is where the Udupi Cochin Shipyard is situated. This offers a local opportunity for candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: The UCSL Diploma Apprentice posts are classified as Contractual job type. While it is a government organization, the specific nature of these roles is for apprenticeship on a contractual basis.
